# braze_catalog (List Resource)

Discover catalogs in the configured Braze workspace. Results identify each catalog by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use alongside a .tf file containing required_providers and provider configuration.
# Terraform 1.14 or later.
list "braze_catalog" "existing" {
  provider         = braze
  include_resource = true
  limit            = 100
}
```
